subtopics.title: Reasons for Synthesizing Data
subtopics.summary: Explores the motivations behind generating synthetic data, including scaling training sets, addressing data scarcity, and improving model performance across different training phases.

subtopics.title: Traditional Data Synthesis Techniques
subtopics.summary: Covers rule-based methods and simulation-based approaches for generating synthetic data without relying on AI models.

subtopics.title: AI-Powered Data Synthesis
subtopics.summary: Describes the use of foundation models to generate instruction data and other synthetic examples, including template-based generation and model distillation.

subtopics.title: Data Verification Methods
subtopics.summary: Focuses on techniques for verifying synthetic data quality, such as programmatic verification through code execution and back-translation.

subtopics.title: Limitations of Synthetic Data
subtopics.summary: Discusses challenges associated with AI-generated data, including model collapse, quality control issues, and superficial imitation problems.
